title.narrative: EU Support to large-scale sustainable investments in Mexican capital markets

description.narrative:
The main objective is to boost green finance and investments in Mexico by enabling a conducive environment for private sector actors and IFIs to leverage green and inclusive financing.

Expected outputs are:

  1. Improved capacity of businesses, investors and financial institutions for formulation, implementation and monitoring of Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) principles and their operationalization in market activities.
  2. Improved capacity of businesses, investors and financial institutions for developing and issuing ESG-based debt and capital financial products.
  3. Improved knowledge of stakeholders on an institutional framework and high-standard taxonomy system for sustainable finance.

title.narrative: Number of private sector entities supported in the structuring, issuance and/or monitoring of sustainable financial products, disaggregated by companies, investors / type of product

description.narrative: This indicator tracks the number of private sector entities that have received support in the structuring, issuance, and/or monitoring of sustainable financial products in Mexico. It encompasses companies and investors that engage in sustainable finance initiatives, including green bonds, social bonds, sustainabilitylinked loans, and other ESGrelated instruments. The indicator is disaggregated by type of entity (e.g., companies, investors) and type of financial product, allowing for a detailed understanding of where support is being channeled and which financial instruments are gaining traction. It serves as a measure of progress in mainstreaming sustainable finance practices and enhancing private sector capacity to mobilize capital towards environmental and social objectives.

title.narrative: Number of private sector entities (investors, businesses, banks) having adopted, or implemented and/or improved ESG strategies in Mexico, disaggregated by sector

description.narrative: This indicator measures the number of private sector entities in Mexicoincluding investors, businesses, and banksthat have adopted, implemented, or improved Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) strategies. It tracks progress in integrating sustainable and responsible business practices across the private sector and provides insight into the extent of ESG alignment within various industries. The data is disaggregated by sector to highlight trends, gaps, and sectorspecific progress, enabling more targeted policymaking and support. This indicator serves as a key metric for assessing the private sectors contribution to sustainable development and responsible investment in Mexico.
